content: R1b completion ladder (niriWayle): 109/118 -> 112/118 -> 116/118 -> 118/118 ALL PASS (run 2026-11-05T21-24-11Z; 59 targets 34 covered + 25 installed 0 missing exit 0). Fixes: audit trap-fallback (Exec=/bin/false targets re-derive from the packaged override's upstream exec, or stay bus-name-only when the override ships inside the supervision package itself — chicken-and-egg); aports provides round 2 (oo7-user-dinit r7 bus names, avahi-dinit r9, bluez-dinit r8 — all VERSIONED, CI 41750591933); niriWayle rules daemon parity (accountsservice PPD udisks2 cups-pk-helper kcron goa EDS xdg-desktop-portal-wlr — no daemon = no activation file = audit blind); dropped the interim post-audit boot.d relink (desktop step 13 links AFTER the audit; interim block checked .user-less names); harness log_errors allowlists the audit CMD echo (--no-fail contains 'fail'). klogd-openrc moved to standardPackages (dfab872). Also: --no-fail split (installer exit always 0; boot/CLI/CI strict exit 1 = user-visible signal; oneshot restart=false). feralos develop c9512cd+729cd61+dfab872+e073ff3+docs.

R1b trap-chicken-and-egg: a supervision package may carry BOTH the dbus overrides for its /bin/false upstream traps AND the units — at audit time the override is absent (package not yet installed), so the trap target must stay in the scan with bus-name-only identity and resolve via VERSIONED provides on the supervision package. Related: the desktop boot.d linking runs AFTER the audit in chroot_phase.Run — no post-audit relink needed. Rule of thumb: no daemon installed = no activation file = audit structurally blind (daemon parity must live in the rules).
